decision.future_readmission_gate: Require a concrete exact-source sm90 compile with <=128 registers/thread, zero spills, <=81920 shared bytes, no materialized probability tensor, no repeated QK/K page traffic, captured exact strides/storage offsets, and the same CPU/reference mapping oracle.
decision.reason: The underfilled-grid premise is false at exact c32: stock already has 1,024 CTAs, eight waves, and 3.03% slot waste. Scheduling-only packing changes none of those quantities. Legal d512 value slicing requires 1.5x-2.5x issued work and no fewer resource-weighted waves; the staged alternative adds ordered task families and probability traffic, while page-size-1 KV prevents TMA gather. The negative control confirms that occupancy purchased through spills regresses.
decision.scope: Closes these three prescribed decompositions for the exact pinned M384 target verifier. It does not close a materially different attention algorithm that proves compiler resources and eliminates repeated QK/state traffic.
